decisions.reason: Replacing the iOS tutorial images with a YouTube video makes the current reusable localized tutorial-asset strategy obsolete for iOS size optimization.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Tutorial images were replaced by the youtube video in the latest version.

decisions.reason: The source change is limited to iOS tutorial delivery and does not establish that Android tutorial images or their size-optimization strategy changed.
The iOS tutorial-media replacement does not change Android full-app localization or its required language coverage.
Replacing tutorial images with a video does not logically change the requirement to localize the full iOS app or its App Store language coverage.
The tutorial-media format change does not alter iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
Using a YouTube video instead of tutorial images does not remove or modify the Apple Privacy Manifest requirement.
The iOS tutorial-media replacement has no necessary effect on Android permission policy or removal of READ_PHONE_STATE.
The source decision concerns iOS tutorial delivery and does not change Android platform compatibility or deprecated-API modernization.
The tutorial-media replacement does not affect the requirement for valid iOS signing certificates and configuration.
Replacing tutorial images with a video does not change the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior elsewhere in the apps.
The tutorial-media replacement does not entail any change to the iPad layout-cleanup requirement.
Application skin graphics are independent of the tutorial images replaced by the YouTube video.
